name: Ranger
cardTexts: Action: Swap a card in your inventory with the top card of any deck
Proc [Odd]: You may look at the top card of any deck
erratas: When you use the Ranger's action, you must swap the card with the same type.
- Mythical Monsters: With Lich, you may swap a card in your inventory with the top of a discard pile

name: Paladin
cardTexts: Action: prevent 1 card's effect
Proc [1, 6]: Untap all of your items

name: Wizard
cardTexts: Passive: Add +1 die on your proc roll
Proc [Doubles]: Swap two revealed cards of the same type

name: Barbarian
cardTexts: Passive: +1 value to each die you roll
Proc [Roll until even]: Add +1 die to your contest for each odd roll

name: Necromancer
cardTexts: Action: discard a card from the top of any deck
Proc [3, 4]: Take any card from the discard pile

name: Slayer
cardTexts: Passive: In an encounter, +1 roll value for each Dragon card drawn
Proc [5, 6]: Double your item effects in Dragon encounters

name: Cleric
cardTexts: Passive: Cannot use items, -1 to Dragon's roll value for each item in your inventory
Proc [4, 5, 6]: +1 roll value for each item in your inventory

name: Rogue
cardTexts: Passive: In a wager, each of your treasures has +200 added value
Proc [Even]: +1 roll value for each treasure wagered

name: Bard
cardTexts: Passive: You have +1 item slot
Proc [2, 5]: Swap any two item cards in inventories or Dragon's hoard

name: Shaman
cardTexts: Passive: +2 dice for any contest with negative treasure(s)
Proc [1, 2, 3]: You may move a treasure from your inventory to another or Dragon's hoard.
